Current data may contain only part of an interrupted import. Keeping it can leave profiles, images and signing credentials inconsistent. Damaged profile styles will be rebuilt from their last saved copies when those copies are valid. Automatic recovery will stop. Restore previous state will no longer be available. Original recovery data and any styles replaced during repair will be preserved on this device for troubleshooting, and will continue to use storage. Continue only if recovery cannot finish.

**Themed icons:** Keep their state and render at a consistent size while browsing and editing.
**Colour segments:** Preview selected icons reliably without blank results or crashes.
**Pack preview:** Show the adaptive background used by themed icons.
**Icon editing:** Use the full app icon or add a soft shadow, hard shadow or glow.
**Colours:** Create lighter blends while preserving the icon’s details.
**Automatic backups:** Keep recent copies and preview a backup before restoring it.
**Installers:** Choose System, Shizuku or a compatible installer on your first build.
**Icon watch:** Recheck outdated suggestions and apply icons directly from notifications.
**Guided tour:** Learn the main controls step by step.
**Installation:** More reliable pack installation with clearer errors.
**Global Style:** A clearer editor with live previews and target controls.
**Modifier presets:** Save and reuse your favourite adjustments.
**Background brushes:** Erase or restore areas with pinch zoom.
**Picker stability:** Fixed a crash caused by duplicate items.
**Gradients:** Use them for icons, backgrounds, shapes and outlines.
**Colour segments:** Recolour separate parts of one icon.
**Build changes:** See what changed and undo icon resets or refreshes.
**Quick actions:** Long-press an app to refresh, watch or reset it.
**Large screens:** Improved layouts for tablets and landscape.
**Global modifiers:** Apply a style by icon source with a live wallpaper preview.
**Online icons:** Search and import artwork from Iconify.
**More styles:** Added Material You, monochrome and inverted colours.
**Responsive layout:** Better support for tablets, foldables and landscape.
**Pack protection:** Shared icons unlock only when their source pack is installed.
**Outlines:** Add or recolour an outline for one icon or the whole pack.
**Welcome guide:** A first-run introduction explains the app.
**Launcher support:** Packs now work with more legacy launchers.
**Lawnicons:** Fixed invisible icons and improved preview quality.
**Safer sharing:** Paid-pack artwork stays locked until its pack is installed.
**Profiles:** Share a setup as a Renkin file.
**Backup:** Save and restore the whole app in one file.
**More sources:** Create text icons or import SVG artwork.
**Material You shapes:** Crop icons or place them on a colour plate.
